facts.fact: ANGOP reports the minister reinaugurated INFOSI's requalified Backup Data Center in Luanda on 2026-08-25, which forms part of the government Data Center and Cloud opened in April 2026 at Camama; main site in Camama (Luanda), backup in Luanda (INFOSI), exact backup place not stated beyond Luanda.
